extraction_metadata.extraction_notes: Single SoA table (ISA Section 1.3) printed over document pages 10-12 under a title band and header reprinted on every page; the intro text on p.9 (delta statement and pointer to the master and CLBP DSA SoAs) is captured as table-wide note g1. Text-layer PDF, not glyph-spread. Marks verified by pdftotext -bbox column binning (no disagreement with the visual read). Cell boundaries from raster rule lines (§1d). Flat table: no group bands. Notes column cells captured as footnote annotations with synthesised markers n1-n17 (five cells split by the sentences that name visits). Abbreviation list dropped. A CCI redaction bar on p.12 covers the label and schedule cells of the rows below 'Epiregulin sample' (the Notes column shows two empty ruled cells there): rows not recoverable.

table_metadata.table_purpose: ISA BP01 (LY3016859, chronic low back pain) schedule (ISA Section 1.3 Schedule of Activities (SoA)): visits and procedures unique to the ISA, on top of the master CPMP and CLBP DSA CPMP(2) SoAs; V3-V7 shared with the master, V801-V803 follow-up added
table_metadata.notes: Title band 'H0P-MC-BP01 ISA' printed inside the frame above the header rows on every page: table_title, not a row (§4). One label column (L=1); data columns at positions 2-10 (V3 -> 2 ... V7 -> 6, V801 -> 7, V802 -> 8, V803 -> 9, ED -> 10); the right-hand Notes column is not a schedule column. Typed main_soa: every participant randomised into this ISA passes through it in sequence. It is a delta schedule: the intro text says it shows only what is unique to the ISA, so the participant's full schedule is this table plus the master and DSA SoAs. The taxonomy has no type for that relation; it is recorded here and in g1.

schedule_properties.property_comment: Top header band: 'Randomization' (V3 only), 'Double-Blind Treatment' spanning V4-V7, 'Follow-up' spanning V801-V803, 'Early Discontinuation' (ED). Typed by the values that span several columns (study phases) -> epoch; the single-column 'Randomization' and 'Early Discontinuation' are values of the band. The label cell is blank, so the name is synthesised.
Visit identifiers V3-V7, V801-V803, ED -> visit.
Study week per visit: 0, 2, 4, 6, 8, 12, 16, 26; blank for ED -> week.

Allowed deviation in days: blank for V3, '±3' for V4-V7, '±5' for V801, '±7' for V802-V803, blank for ED -> window; a qualifier of the columns, so hierarchical_level null. The Notes cell of this row carries 'Minimal interval between 2 doses cannot be shorter than 11 days.' (n1).

annotations.annotation_text: This SoA shows visits and procedures unique to the intervention-specific appendix (ISA) H0P-MC-BP01 (BP01) for LY3016859. Please refer to Master Protocol H0P-MC-CPMP (CPMP) and the CLBP disease-state addendum (DSA) H0P-MC-CPMP(2) SoAs for additional information.
Minimal interval between 2 doses cannot be shorter than 11 days.
Targeted exam for skin, eyes, mouth, lungs, and GI tract should be performed at each visit, in addition to any symptom-driven exam.
Full physical exam should be performed at Visit 803 or ED.
Includes respiratory rate, blood pressure, temperature, and pulse rate.
All vital signs are collected before study intervention infusion on V3-V6.

1-hour IV administration
The timing between randomization and the first IV infusion may be up to, but not longer than, 2 business days to reduce participant burden.
If the participant discontinues after V801, this assessment is not needed for ED per the CPMP SoA.
Use C-SSRS Since Last Visit version.
Required if triggered by the Self-Harm Supplement Form per instructions.
For all premenopausal females or postmenopausal females <50 years of age
V3-V6: collect samples before IV infusion starts and within 15 minutes after IV infusion is complete.
V7-V803: single sample collected at any time.

Obtain PK samples from opposite arm used for IV infusion.
Record date and time of collection.
V3-V6: collect sample before IV infusion starts.
V7-V803: single sample collected at any time to match PK.

review_items.call_made: The note 'If the participant discontinues after V801, this assessment is not needed for ED per the CPMP SoA.' is bound to the activity rows (Rescue medication usage reporting, NRS, PGI on p.10; RMDQ on p.11). It states a condition on the ED mark of the master (CPMP) SoA; this table has no ED mark on these rows, so there is no cell here for it to bind to.
review_items.alternative: Bind it to the empty ED cell (column 10) of each row, or record the location as unresolved because its target is in another document.

review_items.call_made: 'V3-V6: collect sample before IV infusion starts.' (printed in the Notes cells of the ADA and Epiregulin rows) is bound to the marked cells V3, V4, V5 of both rows; neither row has a mark at V6, although the note names V3-V6.
review_items.alternative: Bind the note to the whole row of each activity, or to V3-V6 including the unmarked V6 cell.
